sources.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen3 with LoRA Using NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel: A Complete ...
sources.snippet: We verify the available CUDA hardware and precision support, install NeMo AutoModel directly from its source repository, load an official Qwen3-0.6B LoRA fine-tuning recipe, and programmatically adapt its precision, batch-size, checkpointing, and scheduler settings for a constrained Colab runtime.

sources.snippet: This guide explains step by step how to fine-tune the base model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base on the databricks/databricks-dolly-15k dataset with QLoRA, and how to load the adapter for inference.
